# seismic_art gallery

D3 sketches that turn seismic amplitude into data art (rings, waveform cities, growth
rings, flow fields), served with GitHub Pages.

**Everything shown here is synthetic**: generated by the `seismic_art` project from a
convolutional model, with no real survey and no licensed data. Amplitudes are relative.
Each figure states its domain and polarity.

This repo is a published copy of the `web/` folder of the private `seismic_art` project,
written by its `scripts/publish_gallery.py`. Edit the project, not this copy.

`vendor/d3.min.js` is D3 7.9.0 (ISC licence, `vendor/D3-LICENSE.txt`).
